geometry.initial_geometry_source: same-phase R20 mother crystal circular cut

cell.stress_gate: zz only; lateral stresses recorded, not relaxed

protocol.numerical_provenance: September15 LDA/local lambda=.9,mu=.1 grid test: 60 to 78 changes Eb(1NN) by -0.1705 meV and Eb(2NN) by -0.0759 meV; September16 EOS 78 vs96 gives da0=4.97e-6 A and dB0=0.000627 GPa. Fixed point count retained through variable-cell trajectory; actual spacing recorded. OF density grid is not QE wavefunction cutoff. Nano grid selected at <=0.15 A initial spacing; this is a pilot, not a completed vacuum-grid convergence test. New radius grids retain <=.15 A initial spacing and Nz=96; this is transfer of the pilot spacing, not convergence certification.
protocol.comparison_scope: User explicitly retains different XC/pseudopotentials: QE PAW/PBE versus OF local/LDA. Compare within-method formation/binding energies and structures, never subtract raw absolute total energies across methods.
protocol.stress_candidate: spectral Hessian of sqrt(rho), no smoothing, process-local only
